text:
Ships upon the natal water.
+
+Black water, animal of oblivion. Lilac water, sole wakefulness.
+
+The sunlit mystery of voices in the park. Oh so ancient.

translation.title: Ships upon the Natal Water…
translation.editorial_note: Natal water keeps birth, origin, and fluidity together; black oblivion and lilac wakefulness remain opposed in the poem’s incantatory nominal phrases.
